primaryHitDefinition: 90-day stock return > 0 AND 90-day stock return > SPY return over the same interval
validationTarget: At least 12 of 15 primary hits for a cohort; no reliability claim until at least 3 frozen prospective cohorts / 45 candidates.
note: Populate only after Version 2 evidence inputs are implemented and the cohort is frozen. Do not backfill winners after outcomes are known.
